visualDetailHooks.description: A scar or healed mark tied to a recorded event.
A small emblem from the Union that shaped them.
A cord, stitch, or charm associated with a mentor lesson.
A visible repair on personally important equipment.
A culturally appropriate token from home, used with permission.
A Guild Chronicle pin earned through public service.
Subtle Abyss residue that reacts near remembered floors.
A gate-colored highlight tied to a legal Turning Point.
A practical staff mantle replacing combat gear.
A rescue-team marking chosen by the character.
A knot added after an apprentice graduates.
A piece of a reformed Union banner.
An Invocation Artifact resonance mark, not ownership branding.
A civic-service badge from ordinary citizens.
Paired equipment notches marking respectful contests.
A practical patch showing infirmary or field-healer duty.
Ink or record tags associated with Chronicle work.
A restrained visual response linked to a Fate Scar.
A work mark from crafting history.
A folded map or route charm from a successful return.

visibleClues: People repeat the recruit’s name after missions.
Union members reference a defining memory.
A personal quest gains an expanded stage.
